## Unicode Character Encoding

When language files are generated, non-ASCII characters may be written as Unicode escape sequences, For example:

```yml
actions_menu_title: "\u0434\u0435\u0439\u0441\u0442\u0432\u0438\u044f"
```

This is the Unicode escaped representation of:

```text
действия
```

The characters are not changed or corrupted. `\uXXXX` sequences represent the corresponding Unicode code points, and the YAML parser converts them back to the original characters when the file is loaded

This is **normal** behavior when the language configuration is serialized and does not affect how the translated text is displayed in-game

:::note
This language is translated and generated by AI
:::
